title: Build progress (mutable overlay over the gate-locked matrix and slice plan)

slices.description: Slice id -> status. Overrides `status:` in plan/slices.yaml (gate-2).

features.description: Feature id -> status. Overrides `status:` in matrix/features.yaml (gate-1).

runbook_amended.description: Slice ids whose boundary wrote something into plan/BUILD_RUNBOOK.md — the S1 entry for the initial write, one per `## Amendment after S<n>` thereafter. Exists so slice-review.mjs can tell a boundary that had nothing to add from one that skipped the question: without it, both look like silence, and only one of them is fine.

notes.description: Free-form per-slice remarks carried into the parity report.
